quiz.question: Why is @functools.wraps important?
options: Creates a logger named after the module (e.g., myapp.utils.db).
Objects subscribe to events and get notified when events occur.
__exit__ is still called with the exception info (exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb).
Without it, the decorated function loses its original __name__, __doc__, and other metadata. @wraps copies these from the original function to the wrapper.
